trello.name: Configure Stripe subscription products and prices
trello.desc: Create Stripe products and recurring prices for three subscription tiers: Basic $29/month with basic AI model selection tool and limited feature set, Pro $49/month with additional features and priority support, Enterprise $99/month with all features, custom support, and integration options. Ensure tiers are correctly reflected in Stripe dashboard with metadata for feature mapping and are ready for API consumption by frontend and backend. Owner Taylor is responsible for Stripe setup in coordination with Alex for feature definitions. Acceptance criteria: three active prices exist in Stripe, metadata matches spec, Alex confirms tier details before go-live. Due: within 2 weeks initial integration window, priority high.

trello.name: Implement Stripe Elements checkout UI
trello.desc: Build frontend checkout flow using Stripe Elements that matches app design system, is customizable and secure, and handles errors gracefully for invalid card details, insufficient funds, and other payment failures. Checkout button must be prominent. Include tooltip/help icon explaining plan change implications. Owner Jordan. Acceptance criteria: Elements form renders styled to match app, validation errors shown clearly, successful payment redirects correctly, design review passed. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Update pricing page with tier comparison
trello.desc: Update public pricing page to display Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with clear feature comparison table, pricing, and prominent checkout CTAs per tier. Ensure UI is clean and straightforward and users can easily understand value per plan. Owner Jordan. Acceptance criteria: pricing page reflects $29/$49/$99 tiers, feature comparison accurate, checkout buttons functional, tooltip about plan changes present. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Build subscription management user dashboard
trello.desc: Create user dashboard section showing current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, access to invoices and payment history, and ability to update payment methods. Dashboard must reflect subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes such as successful upgrades or payment failures. Owner Jordan for UI with backend support from Taylor for data. Acceptance criteria: dashboard displays real-time plan status, upgrade/downgrade/cancel actions work, invoices list loads, payment method update works, notifications shown. Due: within 2 weeks for initial integration, testing in week 3.

trello.name: Implement backend Stripe API integration for subscription lifecycle
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe API on backend to create and manage subscriptions, process successful and failed payments, and support subscription updates. Include endpoints for creating subscription on plan selection, processing payments, and retrieving subscription state for dashboard. Owner Taylor. Acceptance criteria: API can create subscription, retrieve subscription, update subscription, handle payment outcomes, responses consumed by frontend. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Implement webhook handlers for subscription events
trello.desc: Set up and test webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded to confirm payments and activate/continue subscription, invoice.payment_failed to notify users and prompt payment method update with email notification, and customer.subscription.deleted to update access rights and optionally offer re-subscribe. Handlers must update internal system state correctly. Owner Taylor. Acceptance criteria: webhooks receive and process three events, system state updates, email sent on payment failure, logs created. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Create test plan and test scenarios for subscription flow
trello.desc: Prepare detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for entire subscription flow from sign-up to billing to subscription management. Include scenarios for payment success, payment failure, cancellation, upgrade/downgrade, webhook delivery, and edge cases. Share plan with Jordan and Alex for coordination. Owner Taylor lead, Jordan collaborates. Acceptance criteria: test plan document shared, test scenarios for success/failure/cancellation covered, automated tests drafted. Due: before testing week, testing week after initial 2-week integration.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend API for real-time updates
trello.desc: Connect frontend dashboard and checkout components to backend Stripe API endpoints so subscription changes are reflected in real-time on dashboard. Ensure error handling during integration provides clear user notifications. Owner Jordan with Taylor for API contract. Acceptance criteria: dashboard updates without manual refresh, checkout success updates UI, errors displayed clearly to user. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Implement user notifications for subscription events
trello.desc: Add in-app and email notifications for subscription confirmations, successful plan upgrades, payment errors, and payment failures with instructions on how to fix. Ensure notifications are clear and actionable. Owner Jordan for UI notifications, Taylor for email triggers on webhook events. Acceptance criteria: users receive confirmation on signup, error messages with remediation steps on payment failure, upgrade confirmation shown. Due: within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Draft user documentation and FAQ for subscriptions
trello.desc: Plan and produce user-facing documentation and support materials including help section/FAQ covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, update payment methods, handle issues, and what happens when changing plans. Owner Alex coordinating with Jordan for UX copy. Acceptance criteria: FAQ covers common subscription questions, instructions for managing plan, invoices, and troubleshooting published before go-live. Due: prior to launch, after integration.

trello.name: Document backend API endpoints and webhook handlers
trello.desc: Document all backend API endpoints related to subscriptions and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting. Include request/response examples, event payloads, and processing logic. Owner Taylor. Acceptance criteria: API docs complete and accessible to team, webhook handler logic documented. Due: within 2 weeks, updated during testing.

trello.name: Schedule weekly follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Set up next follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on Stripe integration, address blockers, and coordinate frontend-backend alignment. Ensure agenda covers progress updates from Jordan and Taylor. Owner Alex. Acceptance criteria: meeting scheduled with all participants, agenda sent. Due: within 1 week.
